title: Home check — nobody home until eight
purpose: A fresh-food box for M. Aydın is due between 17:00 and 19:00. Fresh food is handed over in person. Find out whether somebody will be home, and if not, from when.
otto_says: Hello, this is Otto from the delivery office. Am I speaking with Mr Aydın?
they_say: Not before eight, I'm afraid — I'm at the gym until then.
they_know: Home from 20:00. Tomorrow between 17:00 and 19:00 would also work. No neighbour should take the box.
must_establish: whether somebody will be home between 17:00 and 19:00
from when somebody will be home
outcome: Nobody home before 20:00 — the driver comes after eight, or tomorrow 17:00–19:00; the office tells the driver.

title: Tell the driver — Aydın home after eight
purpose: Pass on what the customer said and agree what the driver does with the stop.
previous_call: Aydın at Husemannstraße 14 is home from 20:00; tomorrow 17:00–19:00 would also work.
they_say: Eight is after my shift. Tomorrow then?
they_know: The shift ends at 19:30. Tomorrow's round passes Husemannstraße 14 at about 17:40.
must_establish: ["what the driver does with the stop", "when the box will be delivered"]
outcome: The box goes on tomorrow's round, at Aydın's about 17:40 — the office tells the customer.
